dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: ...Huh? That's not the price we agreed on, whaddaya think you're playing at?

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Dear Miss Jahoda, if you manage to return the object of your next commission intact, then I assure you your reward will be paid in full.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Ugh... I—It wasn't my fault! How was I supposed to know a bunch of monsters were gonna jump me outta nowhere and knock me into that river...

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Might I also ask that you don't spread so much misinformation to our clients when you're escorting them in the future?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: I—I wasn't spreading misinformation... Most of what I said was... based firmly on the truth.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: "The master bandit who has stolen from every town and village in Nod-Krai"...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Th—That was just me trying to sound cool! No one told me the client was from the Fontaine Gardes! She wouldn't stop questioning me the whole way...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: That woman takes herself too seriously — no sense of humor at all. I can't believe she asked the guild to revoke my membership!

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: "The fixer who protects all of Nasha Town"...

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: I—I was talking about Boss Nef! I was telling the client about her!

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Regardless, Miss Jahoda, if you wish to take on any more commissions in the future, it would be best...

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: I know, I know, "Be careful what you do and say"... Boss Nef's always yammering on at me — but my mouth gets all itchy when I don't use it too long...

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Perhaps you could take a few pointers from our experienced adventurer here.

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: #{NICKNAME}? I guess... {M#He's}{F#She's} not the worst person to learn from.

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: But you're gonna need to wait for me to take this reward back to Boss Nef first.

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Urgh... She ain't gonna be happy that it's not the full amount. I feel a lecture coming...
